title: 2005 AMC 10A 9
statement: Three tiles are marked X and two other tiles are marked O. The five tiles are randomly arranged in a row. What is the probability that the arrangement reads XOXOX?

solutions.text:
The three X positions can be any of \(\binom{5}{3} = 10\) equally likely choices, and exactly one of them produces XOXOX. So the probability is \(\dfrac{1}{10}.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Count the distinct arrangements of three X’s and two O’s in a row
The two O’s occupy \(\binom{5}{2}\) equally likely position sets, and only one of them gives XOXOX
